summary: This Form 6-K from Vodafone Group reports routine director/PDMR share transactions under the Global Incentive Plan. The filing discloses the vesting of conditional performance share awards for executives — the CEO and General Counsel — at nil cost, followed by sales to satisfy tax withholding obligations at GBP 1.215413 per share. No special situation is involved; it is a standard equity compensation disclosure. The appropriate classification is "None" because the filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. Investors should monitor for any future significant insider selling patterns, but no deal mechanics or risk-arb angles apply.
